Top-rated lip glosses stand out depending on whether you are looking for iconic shine, budget-friendly hydration, or a touch of color:

#### Top Picks & Favorites

1. **Best Overall / Icon:** Fenty Beauty Gloss Bomb Universal Lip Luminizer[Fenty Beauty Gloss Bomb Universal Lip Luminizer](https://fentybeauty.com/products/gloss-bomb-universal-lip-luminizer-fuy) 
	- *Why it’s loved:* Infused with shea butter and reflective mica, it delivers an explosive, non-sticky shine with a peach-vanilla scent that flatters a huge range of skin tones.[[1]](https://www.nytimes.com/wirecutter/reviews/best-lip-gloss/)
2. **Best Drugstore / Hydrating:** Maybelline New York Lifter Gloss[Maybelline New York Lifter Gloss](https://www.maybelline.com/lip-makeup/lip-gloss/lifter-gloss-lip-gloss-makeup-with-hyaluronic-acid) 
	- *Why it’s loved:* Formulated with hyaluronic acid, it visibly smooths lip surface lines and provides a plump, high-shine look without breaking the bank.[[1]](https://www.byrdie.com/best-lip-glosses-4165377)[[2]](https://www.nytimes.com/wirecutter/reviews/best-lip-gloss/)
3. **Best Everyday Comfort:** NYX Professional Makeup Butter Gloss[NYX Professional Makeup Butter Gloss](https://www.nyxcosmetics.com/lip/lip-gloss/butter-gloss-non-sticky-lip-gloss/NYX_089.html) 
	- *Why it’s loved:* A cult-classic budget favorite offering a pillow-soft, non-sticky glide with sheer-to-medium coverage across a massive shade range.[[1]](https://www.byrdie.com/best-lip-glosses-4165377)
4. **Best Gloss-Stain Hybrid:** Violette_FR Lip Nectar[Violette_FR Lip Nectar](https://www.violettefr.com/pages/lip-nectar) *(Allure Best of Beauty Winner)* 
	- *Why it’s loved:* An oil-in-water emulsion that combines the high shine of a gloss with the longwear and silky hydration of a shea-butter-spiked stain.[[1]](https://www.allure.com/story/best-of-beauty-2026-lips-winners)
5. **Best Glossy Balm / Peptide Care:** Rhode Peptide Lip Treatment[Rhode Peptide Lip Treatment](https://www.rhodeskin.com/products/peptide-lip-treatment) 
	- *Why it’s loved:* A rich, glossy hybrid that acts as a treatment, wrapping lips in shea butter and vitamin E for a cushiony, semi-gloss finish.[[1]](https://www.nytimes.com/wirecutter/reviews/best-lip-gloss/)
6. **Best Clean / Milky Shine:** Tower 28 ShineOn Lip Jelly[Tower 28 ShineOn Lip Jelly](https://www.tower28beauty.com/products/shine-on-lip-gloss-jelly) 
	- *Why it’s loved:* Formulated with plant-based oils (like apricot kernel and raspberry seed), it gives the comfort of a balm with the glassy wet look of a gloss.[[1]](https://www.byrdie.com/best-lip-glosses-4165377)

You can explore detailed reviews and find purchasing options directly through guides like Wirecutter's Best Lip Glosses[Wirecutter's Best Lip Glosses](https://www.nytimes.com/wirecutter/reviews/best-lip-gloss/) or Byrdie's Tested Lip Gloss Roundup[Byrdie's Tested Lip Gloss Roundup](https://www.byrdie.com/best-lip-glosses-4165377).[[1]](https://www.nytimes.com/wirecutter/reviews/best-lip-gloss/)[[2]](https://www.byrdie.com/best-lip-glosses-4165377)

If you let me know what you're looking for:

- Do you prefer **clear, nude, or bold shades**?
- Are you aiming for **max plumping**, **lip-oil comfort** , or **long-wearing stain**?
- What is your **budget**?

I can narrow down the **exact right tube** for you!
